# TheoremDesk

**The open-source scientific IDE.** *Compute. Formalise. Discover.*

TheoremDesk is an IDE for mathematicians and theoretical physicists that brings Lean 4, LaTeX, Python, Jupyter and symbolic computation together in one desktop app.

## Status

Early setup. This repository builds TheoremDesk from VS Code's open-source code, using a fork of [VSCodium](https://github.com/VSCodium/vscodium)'s build scripts. The local build is set up but hasn't been run end to end yet, and there are no releases or installers.

- How the TheoremDesk layer works and how to build it: [`theoremdesk/README.md`](../theoremdesk/README.md)
- VSCodium's own documentation: [`README.md`](../README.md) and [`docs/`](../docs)
